card.title: Before your agent buys a token
card.sub: …does it know what it is holding?

segments.text: Before your agent buys a token, or accepts one as payment, it should know what it is holding.
presign-guard now checks the token itself. One call, any Solana or EVM token: a grade, the reasons, and the market.
Bonk? Safe. No red flags, deep liquidity, and years of trading.
A token launched today? Risky. Hours old, thin liquidity, and every reason is listed.
USDC? Safe too. Its issuer can freeze and mint on purpose, so that is context, not a warning.
Agents pay one cent per check with x402, in USDC on Base or Solana. Or ask the free quick verdict over MCP.
